column2: Description
Basic Page Setup with React, start with a simple user interface, maintaining a minimalistic style in order to not draw focus to the page.
Build User Location Entry Field to get a user’s current location with input of a city/location.
Implement a simple user interface, maintaining a minimalistic style in order to not draw focus to the page.
Integrate with a weather API to obtain current weather data based on a given position/location.
Implement a way to get a user’s current location with their permission, or allow input of a city/location.
Play music from playlists which relate to current weather phenomena, using the data obtained from the integrated API.
Implement user-based easy music controls such as skip, play, pause for sound management.
Create Postgres Database using Neon
Implement automatic weather fetches and updates so that music changes as weather in the last given area does.
Implement automatic location selection, selecting the user’s last selected location upon login.
Create backend logic to maintain user accounts with recent locations, preferred moods, and favorite music types.
Implement small UI visuals so that the page corresponds slightly to the current weather at the given location.
Maintain strict data security so that user data is not publicly obtainable.
Implement an ‘offline’ mode, where the music played is chosen by the user rather than obtained through weather data.
Curate multiple usable playlists of songs, each relating to a state of weather (sunny, cloudy, rainy, etc.).
Implement global mode to listen to music inspired by weather in any city worldwide.
Implement “mood adjustment” slider to tune between chill, upbeat, or ambient variants of each weather soundtrack.
Implement notification system to alert users when weather conditions change drastically in their selected location.
Add adaptive visual themes and animations matching time of day and weather.
Enable sharing of current “weather mood” playlists with friends or on social media.
Implement an AI-driven music generator to create new songs based upon current weather and location data.
Perform Rigorous Testing
